evidence.text: Keys are declared with an explicit list of environments; a key added for dev alone does not appear in staging or production.
A new environment does not inherit existing keys automatically.
Environments legitimately differ: some keys exist only in production, some only locally, and production values must differ from lower tiers.

desiredImprovement: Consistency of the key set across every environment of an application
worseningOutcome: Ability to express legitimate per-environment differences
